annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 5938/2023 - Altera a Lei 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet) para prever que provedores de redes sociais identifiquem e sinalizem conteúdos feitos com inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 5938/2023 - Amends Law 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet) to require social network providers to identify and flag AI-generated content
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Lídice da Mata (PSB/BA), Câmara dos Deputados
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 5938/2023 adds Article 21-A to the Marco Civil da Internet, requiring social networks and private messaging providers to identify and flag AI-generated images and videos, for example with an "IA" watermark. The justification cites deepfake nudes targeting women and minors, and misinformation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 21-A to Law 12.965/2014 (Marco Civil da Internet).
Social network and private messaging providers must identify and flag AI-generated images or videos, within the technical limits of their service.
Flagging may use a watermark with the initials 'IA'.
Justified by deepfake nudes of women and minors and by the need to counter disinformation.
